sourceTitle: History of Indian and Eastern Architecture
description: "History of Indian and Eastern Architecture" by James Fergusson is a historical account written in the late 19th century. This work delves into the rich and diverse architectural heritage of India and its eastern counterparts, offering insights into various styles, influences, and the evolution of architectural practices over time.
